plain: Two ways animals respond to pain: actively trying to escape or reduce it, or passively giving up, freezing and not using an exit that is there.
eli5: When something hurts, you either run to get a plaster, or you just sit there and stop trying.
technical: Behavioural categories from animal pain and stress research: active coping (escape, avoidance, self-administered analgesia) versus passive coping (immobility, behavioural despair, failure to use an available escape, as in learned helplessness, Seligman and Maier 1967).
